name: 原子：种草链路 - 任务类型备注字段API数据流验证
description: 技术方案：taobao-cloth-ai-op-serverless在向AFD同步的入参中加入备注信息（新增F0/F0爆款&潜爆/其他），通过 /api/afd/review/inspection/data 查询接口验证备注字段正确传递。使用网络请求拦截验证API入参和出参中remark字段。

steps._comment: ===== 注册网络请求拦截器（覆盖fetch和XHR） =====
steps.expression: (() => { if (!window.__apiCapture) { window.__apiCapture = { requests: [], responses: [] }; const origFetch = window.fetch; window.fetch = async function(...args) { const url = typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : args[0]?.url || ''; const method = args[1]?.method || 'GET'; const body = args[1]?.body || null; const req = { url, method, body: typeof body === 'string' ? body : (body ? JSON.stringify(body) : ''), timestamp: Date.now() }; window.__apiCapture.requests.push(req); const resp = await origFetch.apply(this, args); if (url.includes('inspection/data') || url.includes('inspection/list') || url.includes('task/schedule')) { try { const clone = resp.clone(); const json = await clone.json(); window.__apiCapture.responses.push({ url, method, body: JSON.stringify(json).slice(0, 500), timestamp: Date.now() }); } catch(e) {} } return resp; }; } return { interceptorReady: true }; })()
steps.description: 注册API拦截器（fetch + 响应克隆）

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if ((t.includes('种草') || t.includes('套图')) && (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中'))) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '开始任务' || b.textContent?.trim() === '查看详情'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const capture = window.__apiCapture || { requests: [], responses: [] }; const dataReqs = capture.requests.filter(r => r.url.includes('inspection/data') || r.url.includes('inspection/list')); const dataResps = capture.responses.filter(r => r.url.includes('inspection/data') || r.url.includes('inspection/list')); return { requestCount: dataReqs.length, responseCount: dataResps.length, requests: dataReqs.map(r => ({ url: r.url, method: r.method, bodyPreview: r.body.slice(0, 200) })), responses: dataResps.map(r => ({ url: r.url, bodyPreview: r.body.slice(0, 300) })) }; })()

steps._comment: ===== 进入审核详情触发更多API调用 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { if (row.textContent?.includes('待审核')) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { alreadyInDetail: true }; })()

steps.description: 等待审核详情加载和API调用

steps._comment: ===== 技术方案验证：inspection/data接口返回remark字段 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const capture = window.__apiCapture || { requests: [], responses: [] }; const allReqs = capture.requests; const allResps = capture.responses; const inspectionReqs = allReqs.filter(r => r.url.includes('inspection')); const inspectionResps = allResps.filter(r => r.url.includes('inspection')); const hasRemarkInResponse = inspectionResps.some(r => r.bodyPreview.includes('remark') || r.bodyPreview.includes('备注')); const remarkValues = []; for (const resp of inspectionResps) { const match = resp.bodyPreview.match(/remark["':\s]+([^"',}\s]+)/); if (match) remarkValues.push(match[1]); } return { totalRequests: allReqs.length, inspectionRequests: inspectionReqs.length, inspectionResponses: inspectionResps.length, hasRemarkInResponse, remarkValues, allInspectionUrls: inspectionReqs.map(r => r.url.split('?')[0]).filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i), note: '技术方案：taobao-cloth-ai-op-serverless在向AFD同步入参加备注' }; })()

steps._comment: ===== 验证API返回的remark值在合法枚举域内 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const verify = ${remarkApiVerify}; const validEnums = ['新增F0', 'F0爆款', 'F0 爆款', '潜爆', '其他']; const allValid = verify.remarkValues.every(v => validEnums.some(e => v.includes(e))); return { remarkValuesFromApi: verify.remarkValues, allValidEnum: allValid, apiUrls: verify.allInspectionUrls, hasInspectionApi: verify.inspectionRequests.length > 0 }; })()

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 技术方案：taobao-cloth-ai-op-serverless在向AFD同步入参中加入备注信息；inspection/data和inspection/list接口应返回remark字段
riskPoints: fetch响应克隆可能影响后续页面渲染
API返回的remark字段名可能不是'remark'（可能是'remarkInfo'或其他）
响应拦截仅能捕获页面加载期间的API调用，后续分页加载可能遗漏
XHR请求未被拦截（需额外拦截XMLHttpRequest）
